acceptance_criteria: In packages/tickets/lib/doctor.mjs, an entry with Object.hasOwn(entry, "sig") whose signature is empty, null, non-string, or invalid fails with MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_INVALID even inside the legacy prefix.

In packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs and packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs, chainIsIntact/isChainIntact reject any entry with Object.hasOwn(entry, "sig") whose signature fails entrySigValid.

In packages/tickets/lib/stores/git-tree.mjs, runGit passes a 60000ms timeout to spawnSync and throws operational GIT_READ_FAILED when a git call times out or is killed by a signal even when allowFailure is true.
description: Resolves #544 and #572. In packages/tickets/lib/doctor.mjs, packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs, and packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs, treat any entry carrying an explicit sig property (Object.hasOwn(entry, "sig")) whose signature fails entrySigValid as present-but-invalid (MANIFEST_SIGNATURE_INVALID in doctor) even inside the legacy prefix, reserving legacy-missing tolerance strictly for entries without a sig key. In packages/tickets/lib/stores/git-tree.mjs, bound runGit spawnSync calls with a 60s timeout and fail closed on timeout/signal.
title: tickets: reject present-but-malformed sig in legacy prefix and bound GitTreeTicketStore git reads (#544, #572)
